findings.failure_path: The guard checks only the final path component. If a pre-existing directory symlink under $OUT resolves outside it, a regular file reached through that parent can enter the cache acceptance branch. With a missing leaf, the documented same-directory staging and publish flow can also resolve through that parent. Both paths are possible with a single writer, and the new fixtures cover only leaf symlinks.
findings.smallest_fix: Validate that the destination parent resolves within the trusted $OUT before inspecting or publishing the leaf. Add an intermediate-symlink regression that checks the exit status and verifies that the external directory remains untouched.

findings.failure_path: The loop enforces one hit per surviving MANIFEST row. The packet also omits the full predicate list needed to verify that two registrations cannot claim the same fence.
